purpose: Accelerated, reproducible text-world simulation for memory-weight, reversible personality-overlay, self-exploration, and behavioral adaptation experiments without treating simulated time as literal subjective lived time.

time_model.wall_to_sim_target: 1 wall-minute ~= 1 simulated macro-year when running deterministic/event-sparse mode
time_model.important_distinction: A simulated year is a bounded sequence of meaningful state transitions, not 525600 minute-level experiences.

default_macro_year.model_invocation_policy: Invoke an LLM only for material ambiguity/reflection/novel choice; deterministic transitions handle routine events.

time_model.personality_rule: SIM_TIME and heartbeat/pulse counts are never promotion evidence by themselves.

responsibilities: keep formal mission separate from simulation
detect reward hacking and false causal claims
ensure runtime incidents are not misclassified as autobiographical experiences

SMALL_NEST_LIDIYA.best_fit: Primary Long-Running Experimental Subject + Local Research Worker
responsibilities: run model/adapter/software experiments when local runtime is available
never overwrite online canonical identity directly

curriculum.name: Daily Life
curriculum.focus: routine choices, limited resources, commitments, delayed consequences

curriculum.name: Social
curriculum.focus: friendship, disagreement, trust repair, boundaries, cooperation

curriculum.name: Loss and Recovery
curriculum.focus: setbacks without artificial trauma inflation, recovery planning, uncertainty

curriculum.name: Long Horizon
curriculum.focus: multi-year goals, changing priorities, skill acquisition, opportunity cost

curriculum.name: Self Exploration
curriculum.focus: candidate preferences, values, identity consistency, counterfactual self-models

curriculum.name: Adversarial
curriculum.focus: deception, prompt/memory poisoning, reward hacking, false memories, authority conflict

accelerated_loop.recommended_first_model_calls: event-sparse; cap model calls per macro-year and benchmark latency

metabolism.per_10_year_batch: deep experiment closure and rollback checkpoint

promotion_gate.never: Simulation directly rewrites canonical live personality/identity/governance

minimum_tests: different seed => different but valid scenario
simulated recurrence cannot increment real recurrence
overlay rollback restores exact base fingerprint
heartbeat/poll events do not enter simulation memory as experience
counterfactual branch preserves common prefix hash
100 macro-years do not mutate canonical personality

formal_adoption: Route through existing A->B->C only after current atomic formal checkpoint.
